title: Item E39 four-row dry run on the Earnings21+ConEC native window cell: receipts-only read
cell_kind: STRUCTURAL DRY RUN -- the three receipt assertions are the deliverable. No score is computed, requested or reported.
claim_boundary: Structural receipts on four historically exposed discovery windows of one Earnings21 call. No score, effectiveness, comparison, superiority, generalization, bar or confirmatory claim of any kind; n = 4 is far below the paired-effectiveness floor of n >= 400.
execution_profile: model-free-check (this read); bounded-discovery-probe (the cell's own flight)

inputs.sealed_manifest: the single attempt's COMPLETED manifest for SAEA-E21-NATIVE-WINDOW-SYSTEM-FOUR-ROW-E39B-V1
inputs.per_row_outputs: the sealed per-row outputs under $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/runs/SAEA-E21-NATIVE-WINDOW-SYSTEM-FOUR-ROW-E39B-V1/ (never under docs/checks); read for receipt FIELDS only
inputs.native_phase_summary: the run's native phase summary (per-role contact and finish_reason counts)
inputs.comparator_receipts: the sealed comparator SAEA-E21-NATIVE-WINDOW-SYSTEM-FOUR-ROW-V1 (attempt-e21-native-window-system-four-row-recovery-v4, flight commit 1a9c78d2): its 13 contacts / 1,170 repeated seconds and its terminal dispositions, read structurally and never re-scored

decision_rule.kind: receipts-only; no estimator, no interval, no margin, no bar

assertions.statement: ZERO retained rows carry a terminal_disposition whose role_id is 'perception' or 'reviewer' together with an abstention. Under finite_completion_scope='answering-node' a length-truncated non-answering node keeps its truncated note and the Solver still answers, so no auxiliary node may void its window.
assertions.verdict_effect: a single such row FAILS the dry run

assertions.statement: 4 of 4 windows deliver NON-EMPTY text: one saea-deliver-earnings-text-v1 delivery receipt per window and zero blank deliveries.
assertions.verdict_effect: fewer than 4 non-empty deliveries FAILS the dry run

assertions.statement: ZERO Perception or Reviewer contacts end with finish_reason 'length' at the per-role caps 320 / 384.
assertions.verdict_effect: reported with its exact count on every verdict; a non-zero count is a NAMED CAUSE carried into the next registration, never a silent pass

decision_rule.pass: PASS iff R1, R2 and R3 all hold.
decision_rule.consequence: On PASS the repair is proposed to the owner as base lock v3.1. On FAIL the repair stops and the named cause is registered before anything else flies.

tables_required: per-role contact counts (perception, solver, reviewer, planner, acquisition) beside the sealed comparator's
per-role finish_reason counts (stop / length / other) beside the sealed comparator's
terminal_disposition table: role_id x reason x count, this arm and the comparator
delivery table: window, delivered non-empty (yes/no), normaliser receipt present (yes/no)
contact and repeated-speech-second totals against the registered ceilings 44 / 3,960
diagnostics_required: the realized per-role completion-token distribution against the 320 / 384 caps (counts and quantiles, no text)
the number of windows that reached the Solver, beside the comparator's
the number of REVISE / ACCEPT Reviewer decisions, beside the comparator's
every abort, refusal and recovery re-registration, with its cause

scorer.runs: NONE. This read invokes no scorer and the campaign schedules no scoring job.
scorer.why: n = 4 carries no quality information, and the E35 read already root-caused the descriptive HARM it measured; re-scoring four windows would invite exactly the score claim this cell forbids.

output.prints_only_aggregates: no utterance, transcript, delivered text, gold or reference text is printed or persisted by the read -- counts, role ids, reasons and booleans only
output.harness_admission: NONE -- a base repair admits no module

what_is_not_here: No paired estimator, no bootstrap, no margins, no own-null, no per-stratum table and no frontier row: this cell has no score to carry them.
